text:
Sofia L: Heads-up: marketplace partners asked for a clear SEV escalation bridge pattern yesterday. We need something light, auditable, and privacy-friendly for HW partners. Thoughts?
Diego P: +1. Proposal: federated bridge model. Each partner gets an invite-only channel + optional global bridge channel for cross-partner issues.
Grace H: Love the invite-only idea. Legal wants retention rules and a short audit checklist for when we bring partners into a shared channel.
Sofia L: Agree. Minimum must-haves: 1) Naming convention `#partner-<org>-sev` 2) Pinned runbook 3) Invite list + NDA flag 4) Audit checklist.
ops-bot: Template instantiated: `/partner create-channel acme-hw --private --template sev-basic`
Diego P: For actual escalation flow I suggest: A) Triage in partner channel (5m ack), B) If infra, tag `@sre-oncall`; C) If needs partner-engagement, tag `@partnerships-oncall` + open bridge; D) For P0/P1 automatically create war-room.
Grace H: Add evidence collection step before war-room: collect logs, user impact summary, first failure timestamp. We should add a 1-line command partners can run to upload logs: `curl -F "file=@/tmp/log.tgz" https://uploads.redwood/incoming?partner=acme-hw`
Nina V: Question: who can page SRE? We must enforce MSA-approved pagers only. We should publish a signed list and a short verification handshake in the channel for new pagers.
Tom R: Ops automation idea: when partner posts `!escalate P1`, bot runs validation (NDA check, pager allowed) and then: 1) creates bridge `warroom-ACME-<id>`, 2) posts caller list, 3) sets channel topic to `SEV P1 - warroom open`.
Sofia L: Nice. Keep manual override for humans if automation fails.
Diego P: Also plan fallback routing if our hosted inference is impacted: auto-switch partners to their Dedicated tenant (if provisioned) and post a notice. Small toggle endpoint will do it: `POST /ops/fallback?partner=acme-hw&to=dedicated`
Grace H: Pinned runbook should include: contact matrix, ack/resolve SLOs, data handling rules (what can be shared in-channel), war-room call tree (phone numbers), and post-incident evidence retention period.
Nina V: I'll coordinate with legal to create the NDA/retention flags and the pager whitelist. ETA Wednesday EOD.
Tom R: I'll prototype the `!escalate` bot flow and the fallback toggle script. PR by Friday.
Diego P: I'll author the partner channel template and runbook scaffolding.
Sofia L: Action items recap: Nina 91 NDA & pager whitelist (Wed EOD); Tom 91 bot + fallback prototype (Fri); Diego 91 channel template + runbook (Thu); Grace 91 evidence checklist + retention policy (Thu). I'll schedule a 30m sync Thurs 10am PT to finalize.
Grace H: Quick note: include a short postmortem owner assignment rule in the runbook: partner-engage leads initial report, SRE leads technical RCA.
ops-bot: Reminder set for 2025-10-02T17:00:00Z to review templates.
Sofia L: OK team — if no objections, we'll roll this to the first three marketplace partners as a beta. Ping here with blockers.
Diego P: No blockers from infra.
Nina V: Legal cleared the NDA skeleton, will attach doc to runbook when ready.
Tom R: Starting PR draft now.
Grace H: I'll draft the evidence checklist and paste into the runbook when done.
Sofia L: Great, thanks everyone.
